goal: Archive the Lanterns troll bit before Reddit moderation erased the evidence
body: Dave watching HBO's Lanterns hit the art-school scene with John Stewart and immediately clocked Kyle Rayner DNA. His running joke: the episode was already Black enough, then John 'took two white men's jobs' by occupying Hal Jordan's traditional lead/replacement lane while also borrowing Kyle Rayner's artist-coded backstory. Reddit post title: 'Kyle Rayner who?' The post reportedly reached about 1.6K views before moderators removed it. Core comedic engine is lore-grounded trolling: real Green Lantern continuity observation wrapped in deliberately radioactive race-bait phrasing. Preserve as a character/fandom comedy beat, not as factual racial analysis.
